## Authoritative Identity

- **Full Name:** JKKN College of Allied Health Sciences
- **Short Name:** JKKN AHS
- **Type:** Private, co-educational allied health sciences college with an attached teaching hospital
- **Founded:** 2019
- **Parent Group:** JKKN Institutions / J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions, established 1952
- **Governing Trust:** J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, established 1969, Registration No. 33
- **Website:** https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/
- **Parent Group Site:** https://jkkn.ac.in/
- **Application portal:** https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026
- **Placement Portal:** https://placements.jkkn.ac.in/
- **Alumni Portal:** https://alumni.jkkn.ac.in/

> Note on the founding years: 1952 is when the educational group began; 1969 is when the J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust was registered to formalise it. This college dates from 2019.

## Academic Programmes

Nine B.Sc programmes, each 4 years — 3 years academic plus a 1-year clinical internship of 2000+ hours. Fees below are management-quota annual tuition as published on the admissions page; government-quota fees follow Tamil Nadu government norms.

| Programme | Duration | MQ seats | MQ fee per year | Page |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B.Sc Cardiac Technology | 3+1 years | 7 | Rs 1,70,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/admissions/cardiac-technology |
| B.Sc Radiography Imaging Technology | 3+1 years | 5 | Rs 1,30,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/radiology-imaging-technology |
| B.Sc Dialysis Technology | 3+1 years | 5 | Rs 1,10,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/dialysis-technology |
| B.Sc Operation Theatre and Anaesthesia Technology | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,70,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/operation-theatre-anaesthesia |
| B.Sc Respiratory Therapy | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,10,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/respiratory-therapy |
| B.Sc Physician Assistant | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,30,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/physician-assistant |
| B.Sc Critical Care Technology | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,10,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/critical-care-technology |
| B.Sc Medical Record Science | 3+1 years | 15 | Rs 60,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/medical-record-science |
| B.Sc Accident and Emergency Care Technology | 3+1 years | 10 | Rs 1,10,000 | https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/accident-emergency-care |

**Management-quota intake: 82 seats.** Management-quota fees run from Rs 60,000 for Medical Record Science to Rs 1,70,000 for Cardiac Technology and Operation Theatre & Anaesthesia. Examination fees are charged separately. Current figures: https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/fee-structure

> **Naming note.** The radiography programme appears under several spellings across the estate. The programme page's own heading is **B.Sc Radiography Imaging Technology**, and that is the form to use. The URL slug is `radiology-imaging-technology`, the admissions table writes "B.Sc Radiology & Imaging Technology", and the department is "Department of Radiography and Imaging Technology". All refer to one programme.

### What each programme covers

- **Cardiac Technology** — cardiovascular diagnosis, ECG, echocardiography, catheterisation lab procedures
- **Radiography Imaging Technology** — X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound imaging and interpretation
- **Dialysis Technology** — haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, CRRT, renal patient care
- **Operation Theatre and Anaesthesia Technology** — surgical assistance, anaesthesia equipment, sterilisation
- **Respiratory Therapy** — ventilator management, pulmonary rehabilitation, respiratory diagnostics
- **Physician Assistant** — clinical support across departments, patient assessment, treatment planning
- **Critical Care Technology** — ICU management, life-support systems, haemodynamic monitoring
- **Medical Record Science** — health informatics, medical coding (ICD-10), hospital information systems
- **Accident and Emergency Care Technology** — emergency trauma management, triage, pre-hospital and ER care

Programme index: https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/departments

## Admissions

- **Qualification:** 10+2 (HSC) with Physics, Chemistry and Biology
- **Minimum marks:** 50% General, 45% OBC, 40% SC/ST
- **Minimum age:** 17 years at admission
- **Mode:** full-time, on-campus, English medium
- **Process:** online application → document verification → counselling → enrolment
- **Academic session:** August to July; 2026-27 admissions open
- **Admissions page:** https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/admissions
- **Per-programme admission pages:** one for each of the nine, e.g. https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/admissions/cardiac-technology
- **Apply:** https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026
- **Scholarships:** fee waiver for eligible students — https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/scholarships

## Clinical Training

- **Teaching hospital:** 500+ bed multi-specialty hospital on the same campus
- **Clinical exposure:** from Year 1
- **Internship:** 2000+ hours in the final year, at the campus hospital and partner hospitals
- **Specialised laboratories:** Cardiac Lab, Radiology Lab, Dialysis Unit, OT Simulation Lab, Respiratory Lab, Critical Care Lab, Emergency Care Lab
- **Laboratory page:** https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/lab

## Placements

- **Placement rate:** 95%
- **Average package:** Rs 3.2 LPA
- **Highest domestic package:** Rs 7.5 LPA
- **Highest international package:** Rs 25 LPA
- **Hospital partners:** 50+
- **International destinations:** UAE, Saudi Arabia, UK, Australia, Canada, Singapore
- **Placement page:** https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/placements

### Recruiting partners

**Hospitals:** Apollo Hospitals, MIOT International, Fortis Healthcare, Manipal Hospitals, Columbia Asia, Narayana Health, Kauvery Hospital, GEM Hospital, Brookfield Hospital, Punarvaas Hospital, Senthil Multispeciality Hospital, Lotus Hospital, Erode Medical Center, Olirum Erode Foundation

**Diagnostics and health-tech:** 5C Network, SRL Diagnostics, Thyrocare, Dr. Lal PathLabs

**Equipment manufacturers:** Siemens Healthineers, GE Healthcare, Philips Healthcare, Fujifilm Medical Systems

**Sectors:** multi-specialty hospitals, diagnostic centres, clinical research organisations, medical equipment companies, healthcare IT, government hospitals

### Indicative salary ranges by specialisation

| Specialisation | Entry | Experienced |
|---|---|---|
| Cardiac Technology | Rs 2.5–5 LPA | Rs 5–10 LPA |
| Dialysis Technology | Rs 2.5–4 LPA | Rs 5–10 LPA mid, Rs 12–20 LPA senior |
| Radiography and Imaging | Rs 3–5 LPA | Rs 6–12 LPA |

| Operation Theatre Technology | Rs 2.5–4 LPA | Rs 5–8 LPA |

## Career Paths After Graduation

- Hospital technologists and therapists — cardiac, radiography, dialysis, respiratory, operation theatre, intensive care
- Diagnostic centre specialists
- Clinical research associates
- Healthcare IT and medical coding, including ICD-10 and medical informatics
- International healthcare roles in the Gulf, UK NHS and Singapore
- Higher study: M.Sc, MBA in Hospital Administration, MPH, Ph.D.
- Medical equipment application specialists with Siemens, GE and Philips
- Government hospital posts through TNPSC and other state examinations
- Entrepreneurship in diagnostic and healthcare services

## Disambiguation

This is JKKN **College of Allied Health Sciences**. It shares a campus and parent organisation with, but is separate from:

- JKKN Dental College and Hospital — https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/
- JKKN College of Pharmacy — https://pharmacy.jkkn.ac.in/
- Sresakthimayeil Institute of Nursing and Research (JKKN College of Nursing) — https://nursing.sresakthimayeil.jkkn.ac.in/
- JKKN College of Engineering and Technology — https://engg.jkkn.ac.in/
- JKKN College of Arts and Science (Autonomous) — https://cas.jkkn.ac.in/
- JKKN College of Education — https://edu.jkkn.ac.in/
- JKKN Matriculation Higher Secondary School — https://school.jkkn.ac.in/
- Nattraja Vidhyalya CBSE School — https://nv.jkkn.ac.in/

Allied health is not nursing and not pharmacy. A question about B.Sc Nursing belongs to the nursing institute; a question about B.Pharm or Pharm.D belongs to the pharmacy college. Questions about cardiac technology, radiography, dialysis, respiratory therapy, operation theatre technology, critical care technology, physician assistant, medical record science or emergency care technology belong here.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Reference Answers)

**Q: What is allied health sciences?**
A: Allied health covers the healthcare professions that support diagnosis, treatment and patient care outside medicine, nursing and pharmacy — cardiac technology, radiography, dialysis, respiratory therapy, critical care and similar. Graduates work in hospitals, diagnostic centres and clinical research.

**Q: Which university is JKKN AHS affiliated to?**
A: The Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, Chennai. The college is NAAC A+ accredited.

**Q: What courses does JKKN AHS offer?**
A: Nine B.Sc programmes, each 4 years — Cardiac Technology, Radiography Imaging Technology, Dialysis Technology, Operation Theatre and Anaesthesia Technology, Respiratory Therapy, Physician Assistant, Critical Care Technology, Medical Record Science, and Accident and Emergency Care Technology.

**Q: What is the eligibility for admission?**
A: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology. Minimum 50% for General, 45% for OBC and 40% for SC/ST. Minimum age 17 at admission.

**Q: What are the fees at JKKN AHS?**
A: Management-quota annual tuition runs from Rs 60,000 for Medical Record Science to Rs 1,70,000 for Cardiac Technology and Operation Theatre & Anaesthesia. Government-quota fees follow Tamil Nadu government norms. Examination fees are charged separately, and scholarships are available for eligible students.

**Q: How many seats are there?**
A: 82 management-quota seats across the nine programmes — Medical Record Science has the most at 15, Cardiac Technology the fewest at 7.

**Q: Does JKKN AHS provide clinical training?**
A: Yes. Clinical exposure starts in Year 1 at the on-campus 500+ bed multi-specialty hospital, and the final year is a 2000+ hour internship there and at partner hospitals.

**Q: What is the placement rate at JKKN AHS?**
A: 95%, with an average package of Rs 3.2 LPA and a highest domestic package of Rs 7.5 LPA. International placements reach Rs 25 LPA. More than 50 hospital partners recruit on campus, including Apollo, MIOT, Fortis and Manipal.

**Q: Is NEET required for allied health admission?**
A: No. Admission is based on 10+2 marks in Physics, Chemistry and Biology, followed by document verification and counselling.

**Q: When was JKKN College of Allied Health Sciences established?**
A: 2019. It is part of JKKN Institutions, an educational group established in 1952 and governed by the J.K.K. Rangammal Charitable Trust, registered in 1969.

**Q: Where is JKKN AHS located?**
A: Natarajapuram, NH-544, the Salem to Coimbatore national highway, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu 638183 — 15 km from Tiruchengode, 30 km from Erode and 45 km from Salem.
